arguments.description: Shows the charge level and charging state.
arguments.annotation:
Shows the battery level.

Run it from /apps (Enter) or ask me to run it.
It reads /sys/class/power_supply/BAT0/capacity once a second.

arguments.name: battery_viewer
arguments.content:
#!/bin/sh
while :; do
  cap=$(cat /sys/class/power_supply/BAT0/capacity 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  echo "Battery: ${cap}%"
  sleep 1
done
